title: Pure Nordic
summary: Pure Nordic build with the three Level 10 Aesir Synchro gods (Thor, Odin, and Loki) and generic staples. Link-1 Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant and the 2022 support wave turn any single Nordic monster into a Level 10 Aesir backed by the board-wide negate Trap Nordic Relic Svalinn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Nordic Smith Ivaldi Special Summons itself from the hand while you control an Aesir or Nordic monster, and searches any Nordic Relic card when Normal or Special Summoned.

Nordic Relic Hlidskjalf Special Summons any Nordic monster from the Deck (locking Extra Deck summons to Aesir monsters while that monster is face-up), and banishes itself from the GY to search a Nordic and shuffle a card from the hand into the Deck.
Nordic Beast Gullinbursti is a Level 3 Tuner that can substitute for any Nordic Tuner, summons a Nordic from the hand when Normal or Special Summoned, and adds a Nordic from the GY to the hand.
Gleipnir, the Fetters of Fenrir is a Normal Trap that searches any Nordic monster from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Any Nordic + 1 Card (or Nordic Smith Ivaldi)
steps: Normal Summon Nordic Smith Ivaldi (or any Nordic monster, then Special Summon Ivaldi from the hand) to search Nordic Relic Svalinn.

Link Summon Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant into the Extra Monster Zone and banish up to 3 cards from your hand and/or field (including Alviss of the Nordic Alfar if in hand, or just 1 card to summon Alviss or 3 Nordics totaling Level 10 from the Deck).

If Alviss of the Nordic Alfar is banished by Gullveig's effect, Alviss sends 1 Nordic on the field and 2 from the Deck whose total Levels equal 10 to the GY to Special Summon Odin, Father of the Aesir, Thor, Lord of the Aesir, or Loki, Lord of the Aesir straight from the Extra Deck (or Synchro Summon an Aesir directly with the 3 Nordics Gullveig summoned), then Set Nordic Relic Svalinn.

summary.title: Gullveig & Alviss Shortcut
summary.text: Each Level 10 Aesir Synchro traditionally requires a specific Nordic sub-archetype Tuner (Nordic Beasts for Thor, Nordic Ascendant for Odin, Nordic Alfar for Loki) plus 2+ non-Tuners. Link-1 Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant fixes this in two ways: she can banish 3 cards to summon a Tuner and two non-Tuners totaling Level 10 directly from the Deck while making the Aesir she points to untargetable, or she can banish Alviss of the Nordic Alfar alone so Alviss sends 10 Levels of Nordics from the field and Deck to the GY to cheat out an Aesir from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: The Aesir Gods & Lock
points: Odin, Father of the Aesir (4000 ATK) makes itself unaffected by Spell/Trap effects during your Main Phase, and revives itself from the GY in the End Phase (by banishing a Nordic Ascendant Tuner) to draw 1 card.

Thor, Lord of the Aesir (3500 ATK) negates the effects of all face-up monsters the opponent controls during your turn, and revives itself in the End Phase (by banishing a Nordic Beast Tuner) to burn for 800.

Loki, Lord of the Aesir (3300 ATK) negates an opponent's Spell/Trap activation during your Battle Phase, and revives itself in the End Phase (by banishing a Nordic Alfar Tuner) to recover a Trap from the GY.

Extra Deck Lock: Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant locks you into Special Summoning only Aesir monsters for the rest of the turn after using her effect, and Nordic Relic Hlidskjalf locks your Extra Deck to Aesir monsters while its summoned Nordic is face-up.

summary.title: Nordic Relics
points: Nordic Relic Svalinn (Continuous Trap) negates the effects of all face-up cards your opponent currently controls until the end of the turn once per turn while you control an Aesir monster, and tributes a Nordic to revive an Aesir from your GY.
Nordic Relic Gungnir banishes a face-up Aesir or Nordic monster you control until your second End Phase to destroy 1 card on the field.
Nordic Relic Draupnir boosts an Aesir or Nordic by 800 ATK and searches any Nordic Relic card if destroyed by a card effect.
